gaps.purpose: Independent support/validate/call decisions across accepted, rejected and unconfirmed requirement cases; no baseline-name assumptions
gaps.progress: Independent profiles and admission are connected to all three runtimes. No pinned adapter has an honestly undecidable requirement case; actual start and response acknowledgement loss are verified in G02.

gaps.purpose: Response acknowledgement loss (accepted and unaccepted), confirmed non-delivery, identity, no duplicate native response
gaps.progress: Native start nondelivery and accepted/unaccepted acknowledgement loss bound to Codex/Gemini; usable local Koog handoff verified. Codex response nondelivery/loss bound to actual approval and file effect. Other unavailable channels are not fabricated; physical wire faults and response races are outside this result.

gaps.purpose: Approval/question withdrawal, supersession, in-flight response/cancellation/terminal races
gaps.progress: Actual approval response/cancellation/terminal races and file effects pass. Independent native withdrawal, supersession and caller questions are unavailable in these configurations.

gaps.purpose: Multi-handle context blocking; release/reopen and configured harness/process boundaries
gaps.progress: Shared-context handle lifetime fixed; overlap, start-uncertainty blocking and independent context verified. No application restart or concurrent writer guarantee.

gaps.purpose: Partial output and usage for all four outcomes, missing versus empty, unknown versus zero
gaps.progress: Four outcomes retain captured partial output. Empty/missing native response acceptance differs by provider and is recorded explicitly. Usage retention additionally verified by G11.

gaps.purpose: Cleanup entry/total timing, multiple resources, noncooperative work, actual late effects and retained outcome
gaps.progress: Multiple active resources and cancellation of cleanup caller verified. Evidence includes three Koog tool cases, two previously existing; actual late effects preserve Unresolved.

gaps.purpose: Independent semantic/diagnostic overflow and gap counts under native load
gaps.progress: Independent semantic/diagnostic counted gaps and retained terminal verified under actual stream/tool load.

gaps.purpose: Session grant covered/uncovered targets, no grant widening or cross-session propagation, native effect counts
gaps.progress: Opaque session approval excluded; one-shot approval does not propagate to subsequent tasks or independent sessions. No enforceable native session grant is exposed; covered/uncovered grant branch remains unavailable.

gaps.purpose: Native workspace/skill activation and filesystem/network enforcement
gaps.progress: Codex and Gemini apply active skill bodies and retain inactive skills as available metadata. Codex enforces restrictive filesystem/network upper bounds only with DenyAll; approval policies that could expand those bounds are rejected. Gemini and Koog reject execution constraints they cannot enforce.

gaps.purpose: Structured output enforcement/validation; currently unsupported profiles must reject before work
gaps.progress: All three configurations reject structured output requirements (both validation responsibility flags), in preflight and direct admission: 12 existing G01 executions, not new tests. Actual schema execution remains unsupported.

gaps.purpose: Usage duplicate snapshots/reset/missing segments; message roles/identity and tool/effect correlation
gaps.progress: Seven usage executions plus 18 G05 regressions. Additional identity assertions revalidated in seven G11 and five G03 executions: plain-text roles and delta/completion identity across all three runtimes, two actual Koog tool lifecycles, Codex approval-to-effect identity. Gemini tool/effect correlation and every commentary/explanation variation are not separately native-validated.

gaps.purpose: Persistence failures, desired configuration, runtime support revocation and declared restart coordination
gaps.progress: Six new storage/configuration executions plus six G04 regressions. Live-handle configuration overwrite fixed. Unknown reference and real history-file loss/restoration verified. Unsupported restart/writer scope rejected in G01; no fabricated capability-revocation channel.

acceptanceVerification.koogAcknowledgementLoss: No separate acknowledgement suspension in this configuration; direct handoff regression and usable-handle test apply.
acceptanceVerification.geminiAndKoogResponseLoss: No caller approval channel; actual requirement rejection is covered by G01.
